headline: Joshi Hardik Arunkumar resigns as Company Secretary of The Sandesh Limited

modes.bear: Frequent changes in key managerial personnel can sometimes highlight internal stability issues.
modes.bull: Routine departures of compliance officers rarely impact company fundamentals or long-term growth.
modes.simple: The person in charge of legal and regulatory compliance at Sandesh Limited is stepping down in November 2026. This is a routine administrative change for the company.

summary: The Sandesh Limited has announced that Mr. Joshi Hardik Arunkumar has resigned from his position as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The resignation becomes effective from November 14, 2026. Such changes in key managerial personnel are routine corporate updates for listed entities. Indian retail investors should note this administrative transition as part of ongoing corporate governance monitoring.
whats_next: Appointment of a new company secretary by The Sandesh Limited
why_it_matters: Routine management change with no direct impact on stock price.
